items.title: ARISS names Young Director of Ops; CIO and logistics roles added
items.blurb: ANS-249: Daryl Young, K4RGK, is the new ARISS-USA Director of Operations; Ryan Krenzischek moves to a new CIO seat; Deborah Lebair, KC3YWM, joins the International Board as secretary; Megan Tucker, KQ4MAM, is Logistics Manager. Young recently led the AREx Artemis II ground-station consortium that fed Doppler data to NASA.

items.title: SatNOGS Network 1.128+ and DB 1.76: multi-vetting and station status
items.blurb: Late-August SatNOGS Network releases add multi-user observation vetting, split connected/available/testing station flags, and separate min-horizon vs min-culmination. DB 1.76 renames satellite status values and starts structured transmitter parameters plus a Launches feature for rideshare ID work. Follow-up patches landed after migration and performance hits.

items.title: AMSAT Symposium early-bird pricing ends tomorrow, 8 September
items.blurb: The 44th AMSAT Space Symposium is 8–11 October in Jacksonville at the Wyndham (ex-Crowne Plaza Airport/I-95). Register by 8 September to save $20; tech papers Friday–Saturday with live stream, banquet and auction, optional Sunday tours. Presentation abstracts still wanted at symposium@amsat.org.

items.title: KH8WW American Samoa from Aunuʻu, 10–24 September
items.blurb: Yuris YL2GM and Eugene EA5EL will be KH8WW from Aunuʻu Island (OC-045), American Samoa, 10–24 September. Planned CW, SSB, and FT8 on 160–6 m with two to three stations. QSL via Club Log OQRS (preferred) or YL2GN; full LoTW six months after the trip. Team site is live.

items.title: V47YA and V47RCX on St Kitts from 9 September
items.blurb: Tom K0YA as V47YA and Toni W5RCX as V47RCX operate from St Kitts (QTH V47JA) 9–30 September, then again 3 February–3 March 2027. Holiday-style on 160–6 m, CW, SSB, and FT8. QSL both calls via LoTW.

items.title: S9R São Tomé and Príncipe, 17–31 October
items.blurb: Angolan/Portuguese/Spanish team S9R plans Tamarindos (JJ30hj) 17–31 October with up to four stations (IC-7300, FTdx10, FT-710, FTX-1 for QO-100). Spiderbeam, hexbeam, 40 m vertical, EFHW, and a 5-el 6 m yagi; CW/SSB/RTTY/FT8 (MSHV) plus split pileups. Band plan and QSL policy are on the team site.

items.title: K4SWL: light-pack SOTA on Dirrington Great Law with Alan MM0VPM
items.blurb: Thomas K4SWL’s fresh field report: KH1 and Savotta Niukka on GM/SS-225 with Alan MM0VPM after a sheepdog-side farm hike. Thirteen CW QSOs in ~37 minutes on 20/15 despite poor prop, including S2S Serbia and Liechtenstein; he also puts KI6CR’s concentric KH1 paddle through a filmed activation.

items.title: Route 66 On The Air: W6A–W6W, 12–20 September
items.blurb: Citrus Belt ARC’s 27th Route 66 special event runs 0001Z 12 September through 2359Z 20 September. Twenty-three 1×1 stations (W6A–W6W) along the Mother Road; work at least one before requesting a certificate or decal. Listen for each station’s exchange — no ragchew during the event.
